reuse.reason: The pinned official plugins register pages only under private RemoteAccess catalog grants. Granting those rights to anonymous visitors is invalid, and no official anonymous account-boundary plugin exists to mount or fork. This composition plugin reuses the complete marked manager and Schedule forks, with metadata-only Host faces and action-level login gates. It retains official page layout and styles, adding an official sign-in button only in private configuration seats. Plugin values are deployment declarations, never owner settings or observed fibers. Task previews explicitly request sign-in and do not claim an authoritative private catalog. The Schedule fork exposes an optional onBeforeCreate Host hook; public navigation supplies it, without label/DOM interception. Private registration and Gateway access remain unchanged. Public configuration descriptors remain visible, but the composition renderSlot facade replaces bundle/row configuration pages and summaries with official sign-in controls before any private form component can mount. Explicit bundle registration through the publicPluginConfigurations compatibility service allows self-gated public SaaS panels to mount. Unknown bundles and every row configuration remain denied; disposal revokes the registration.

userApprovedDeviations.change: Allow public browsing with explicit guest copy; request sign-in for account operations while preserving official page layout and all private authorization. Task creation buttons request sign-in before opening an editor that needs private workspace choices.
userApprovedDeviations.approval: The user explicitly requested clickable anonymous navigation and action-level login prompts on 2026-11-17.
